title: August and the Landfall
premise: Felix Dunmore, a storm chaser deep in debt to the Vane Syndicate, agrees to guide a dying prospector named August Reyes on one last expedition into the cyclone-belt badlands, where August claims an abandoned survey station holds something worth more than gold. What they find is evidence of a vast untapped aquifer—and proof that the Syndicate's own founders caused the drought that starved the region, a secret worth killing for. When August dies mid-journey and the Syndicate's hunters close in, Felix must choose between selling the map to clear her debts or bringing the truth home to the drought towns that need it. She chooses the truth, outflies the landfall storm with her ragged found crew, and exposes the Syndicate at the cost of her anonymity—finally learning that staying invisible was never living.
about_author: Ada Thackeray is the pen name of a former meteorological technician who spent six years chasing storms across the high plains before turning to fiction. Her novels blend hard-edged adventure with quiet meditations on debt, duty, and the families we assemble along the way.

chapters.title: The Weight of Water
chapters.summary: Felix's POV. Deep in debt to the Vane Syndicate after a wrecked chase season, Felix takes a desperate contract: escort dying prospector August Reyes into the cyclone belt before the autumn landfall. The emotional beat is weary pragmatism masking grief—she measures life in miles because years have only ever taken things from her.

chapters.title: A Map for a Promise
chapters.summary: August's POV. In a roadside clinic, August trades his weathered map to Felix not for money but for a promise: bring the expedition home, whatever it finds. He hints the station holds 'the reason the rain stopped.' The beat is fragile trust forming between two people who have spent decades alone.

chapters.title: Crew of Strays
chapters.summary: Felix's POV. Assembling a skeleton crew on no budget, Felix recruits disgraced hydrologist Priya Nair and teenage mechanic Theo Okonkwo, who stows away rather than be left behind. The beat is reluctant warmth—the first stirrings of found family, which Felix resents even as she relies on it.

chapters.title: Into the Belt
chapters.summary: Priya's POV. The convoy crosses into the storm belt through dust devils and dead towns, and Priya notices the drought patterns are man-made, not natural. August's health fails; he begins dictating coordinates from memory. The beat is mounting unease as wonder curdles into suspicion about what they're really chasing.

chapters.title: Station Meridian
chapters.summary: Felix's POV. They reach the buried survey station and find the aquifer—a sea beneath the badlands—alongside ledgers proving the Syndicate's founders poisoned the watershed decades ago to force water monopolies. The beat is awe collapsing into horror: the discovery is a weapon pointed at everyone who touches it.

chapters.title: What August Knew
chapters.summary: August's POV, his final chapter. Dying in the station's infirmary, August confesses he was a young Syndicate surveyor who helped bury the evidence and has run from it for fifty years. He makes Felix swear again—not to protect the secret, but to carry it home. The beat is redemption arriving too late to be simple.

chapters.title: Hunters on the Horizon
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. Syndicate trackers find their trail; a firefight at the fuel cache costs them their lead vehicle and nearly Theo's life. Felix realizes the Syndicate will burn the evidence and everyone holding it. The beat is terror sharpening into resolve—the crew stops being passengers and becomes a team.

chapters.title: The Bargain
chapters.summary: Felix's POV. A Syndicate fixer offers Felix full debt forgiveness for the ledgers and August's silence, invoking the promise she made to herself to survive. Torn between duty to the dead and love for the living crew, Felix stalls—then secretly copies everything. The beat is love against duty, decided by a forgery.

chapters.title: Landfall
chapters.summary: Priya's POV. The season's largest hurricane makes landfall directly over their escape route. Racing the eyewall with the Syndicate behind them and the storm ahead, Felix threads the convoy through flooded canyons using every trick of her trade. The climax beat: she gambles her own life to pull Theo's truck out of a surge channel, choosing her crew over her survival instinct for the first time.

chapters.title: Homecoming Rain
chapters.summary: Felix's POV. They deliver the ledgers to a drought-town assembly and a federal investigator; the Syndicate's fixer, moved by the evidence against his own employers, corroborates. Rain falls on the badlands as the aquifer hearings begin. Felix, publicly named and finally visible, plants August's compass at his grave. The beat is inheritance accepted: she stays, and lets herself be known.
